# VENOM Router

> Windows desktop LLM router (Electron 33 + better-sqlite3, v2.1.4). It connects
> thirteen provider adapters and encrypted keys, discovers a live model catalog,
> tests models through main-process networking, and records request telemetry.
> Source is plain JavaScript with no framework or bundler. Everything on disk is
> written in English.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): required read order, commands, boundaries and gotchas
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): binding workflow rules for this checkout
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): boot order, two SQLite databases,
  request lifecycle, IPC groups, renderer globals and proof boundaries
- [docs/CODE_MAP.md](docs/CODE_MAP.md): generated file/symbol/IPC index and
  landmarks for long files
- [docs/COOKBOOK.md](docs/COOKBOOK.md): provider, IPC, setting, log and UI recipes
- [docs/AGENT_TASK_TEMPLATE.md](docs/AGENT_TASK_TEMPLATE.md): delegation card
- [README.md](README.md): current user-facing feature and development guide

## Current facts

- Version: `2.1.4` from `package.json`; never hardcode another version.
- Tests: `npm test` currently reports `918` passing tests under Electron's Node.
- Built-in provider modules: `src/renderer/providers/` currently contains thirteen.
- Data: `venom.db` and `venom-logs.db`; legacy JSON is import-only.
- Security: renderer has no Node/network access; secrets are placeholders in the
  renderer and encrypted/resolved in main.
- Development data: unpackaged `npm start` uses `%APPDATA%\venom-router-dev`;
  packaged builds use `%APPDATA%\venom-router`; live checks use scratch folders.
- Live proof: `verify:live` and focused gates use a mock provider and do not prove
  real-provider, real-key, real-429 or real-stream behavior.

## Guardrails

- Work in this checkout; never create a Git worktree without owner approval.
- Never use `npm start` or a live check against the owner's real data folder.
- Never print, copy or move stored key values.
- Update hand-written architecture/cookbook docs when runtime boundaries change.
- Regenerate `docs/CODE_MAP.md` after adding or moving files under `src/`,
  `scripts/` or `test/`; use `npm run repo:map -- --check` to verify freshness.
- `npm run release` is owner-authorized only because it tags and publishes.

## Historical material

- `CHANGELOG.md` records shipped versions.
- `docs/superpowers/specs/`, `docs/superpowers/plans/` and
  `docs/archive/` are historical design records, not current implementation
  instructions. Read only a named document when a task needs historical intent.
